title: Philips Hue Bridge HomeKit Observable Discrepancy Information Disclosure Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-126980)
description: CVE-2026-126980 is an information disclosure vulnerability in the Philips Hue Bridge's HomeKit Authentication service. The flaw allows network-adjacent attackers to obtain sensitive internal information without authentication by exploiting observable discrepancies in responses to crafted pairing requests on TCP port 8080. This vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 6.5 and may be leveraged alongside other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code on the device.
